name: Naked Edge
source:
Main character's parents were forced to commit suicide in his childhood. Now he learns identity of that horrible person - former co-owner of father's company. Protagonist undertakes steps to become his enemy daughter's tutor. Now all the family is in his reach for revenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母在他小时候被迫自杀。如今他得知了那个可怕之人的真实身份——父亲公司的前合伙人。主角设法成为仇人女儿的家庭教师。现在，整个家族都在他的复仇范围之内。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
